<solution>
The UniProt `sequence.length` field returned 3 for ARDA2B, which is clearly a parsing artifact — the actual sequence string is long. Computing lengths directly from the sequences:

<execute>
import requests

lens={}
for acc in ["P18089","Q9H0A8"]:
    d = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json", timeout=60).json()
    s = d["sequence"]["value"]
    lens[acc]=len(s)
    print(acc, d["uniProtkbId"], "computed length:", len(s), "| reported field:", d["sequence"].get("length"))

a=lens["P18089"]; c=lens["Q9H0A8"]
print("\nADRA2B:", a, "aa ; COMMD4:", c, "aa")
print("ratio ADRA2B/COMMD4 =", round(a/c,3))
print("ADRA2B >= 2x COMMD4?", a >= 2*c)</execute></solution>
